title: Dialogs above the top bar
description: Dialog headers (the PRODUCTION and TRANSACTION eyebrow labels, first lines of panels) were clipped under the app header at 1280x720. While a backdrop dialog is open the overlays layer now sits above the header. Before and after at 1280x720.

shots.heading: Production drawer, before
shots.caption: The panel is centred with max-height 100dvh - 32px, so on 720 px its top (16 px) is under the 47 px header: the PRODUCTION label is cut off by the header bar.

shots.heading: Production drawer, after
shots.caption: The dialog covers the header (dimmed backdrop); the PRODUCTION label and title are fully visible.

shots.heading: Trade desk, before
shots.caption: The TRANSACTION eyebrow of the trade desk sits under the header.

shots.heading: Trade desk, after
shots.caption: The whole trade desk panel is visible.

shots.heading: Choice workflow modal (payment list), before
shots.caption: The payment list in the generic decision modal. Its top is 62 px, so this one fits; it is the control case.

shots.heading: Choice workflow modal (payment list), after
shots.caption: Unchanged apart from the header now being dimmed behind the backdrop.

shots.heading: Objectives modal, before
shots.caption: The score-objective modal (top 54 px) clears the header, so it was not clipped; the header buttons stay bright above the backdrop.

shots.heading: Objectives modal, after
shots.caption: Same position; the header is now under the backdrop like the rest of the page.

notes.title: Fix.
notes.text: .app-shell__overlays:has(.choice-dialog, .choice-workflow-dialog, .decision-modal, .invasion-overlay) { z-index: var(--layer-dialog); }. The container is its own stacking context, so raising only the child never beat the header; the container is raised only while such a dialog is mounted. Banners, prompt bars and toasts keep the lower layer.

notes.title: Check.
notes.text: Each capture asserts the panel top is at or below the header bottom, or the overlays layer is above the header. The before shots were taken on unified-2026-10-08 with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and are committed; npm run screenshots -- AK regenerates the after shots.

notes.title: Fixtures.
notes.text: Synthetic mocked game, not an engine capture.
